description: List events emitted on Starknet (newest first). Optionally filter by emitting contract and/or block. Unbounded lists use cursor pagination (pass `cursor` from a previous response's nextCursor/prevCursor); block-scoped lists use page numbers and return lastPage.

block.description: Filter by block number, block hash (0x...), or "pre_confirmed".

blockEnd.description: Inclusive upper block-number bound for the cursor-paginated lists. Cannot be combined with `block`.

blockStart.description: Inclusive lower block-number bound for the cursor-paginated lists. Cannot be combined with `block`.

cursor.description: Keyset cursor from a previous response's nextCursor/prevCursor. Omit for the first page. Cannot be combined with `block`.

network.description: Network to query. Defaults to the server's configured network (mainnet).

page.description: Page number (1-based). Only honored for block-scoped lists.

pageSize.description: Items per page: 10, 25, 50, or 100. Defaults to 25. Keep small to save context.

timestampFrom.description: Inclusive lower timestamp bound (unix seconds) for the cursor-paginated lists. Cannot be combined with `block` or a block-number window.

timestampTo.description: Inclusive upper timestamp bound (unix seconds) for the cursor-paginated lists.

name: list_events
